adminsHelp: Invite teammates and control their access to administration tools.
rolesHelp: Define access for each role. Permissions are enforced by the backend.
emailLoginHelp: The administrator signs in with this email.
search: Search by email or full name
sessionError: Unable to verify your session. Try again.
forbiddenHelp: Your account does not have permission to open this page. Contact your Super Admin.
sessionExpired: Your session has expired or been revoked. Sign in again.
requestError: The request could not be completed. Please try again.
conflict: That email, username or role code already exists.
invalidInput: Check the information entered. This operation may not be available for the account’s current status.
unavailable: The service or email delivery is not available yet. Try again later.
cooldownError: Please wait 60 seconds before requesting another invitation.
emptyHelp: Adjust your filters or invite an administrator to get started.
systemHelp: SUPER_ADMIN and its membership cannot be changed through this interface.
createHelp: An activation email will be queued. No temporary password is created.
confirmHelp: This change takes effect immediately. Changing roles or status revokes the affected administrator’s sessions.
queued: Email queued · sending not yet confirmed
queuedHelp: QUEUED means the request is in the delivery queue. It does not mean SENT or delivered to the inbox.
notScheduled: Email delivery is not enabled. Contact the system operator.
name: Role name
codeHelp: Uppercase letters, numbers and underscores. The code cannot be changed later.
reserved: IAM permissions are reserved for the system role.
discardHelp: Your permission changes have not been saved.
matrixEmpty: Select a role to review its permissions.
activateHelp: Set your password to finish setting up your administrator account.
passwordHelp: 12–72 characters, including uppercase, lowercase and a number. Maximum 72 UTF-8 bytes.
passwordError: Use a password that meets the requirements and matches the confirmation.
invalidLinkHelp: It may have expired, been used or been revoked. Contact your Super Admin for a new invitation.
activatedHelp: Your password is set. Continue to administrator sign-in.
pendingHelp: Pending accounts cannot sign in until activation. A suspended invitation cannot be activated.
